text:
Leah - People Ops: Heads up — new benefit launching today: Emergency Relocation Leave (ERL). Up to 3 paid days for folks who need to relocate quickly due to family emergency, natural disaster, or immediate safety concerns. Manager approval required; docs optional for the initial claim. Full policy: `https://redwoodintra.company/policies/erl`

Marta - People Ops: TL;DR: 3 paid ERL days + a one-time Home Office Stipend bump ($300) for the relocation month, and a 5-day non-accrual PTO buffer credit usable within 60 days. This is a separate paid benefit, not pulled from your regular PTO balance.

Devon: Thanks — quick q: how do we define "relocate" vs temporary travel?

Leah - People Ops: Good Q — relocate = change of primary residence >50 miles from previous address OR crossing international border to a new residence. Short-term hoteling/travel for work or temporary stays don't qualify.

Samir: Manager workflow? How do I approve fast if somebody's in transit?

Leah - People Ops: Approve in Workday under "Emergency Leave" and note "ERL". If urgent, do a quick-approve and follow up with People Ops within 7 days for minimal verification. We'll audit but won't block urgent support.

Devon: Do ERL days reduce PTO or affect rollover?

Marta - People Ops: No — ERL is separate and does not reduce your PTO balance. The 5-day buffer credit is an additional one-off credit and won't change accruals or long-term caps.

Devon: Any tax / payroll note on the $300 stipend?

Marta - People Ops: Yes — the stipend is taxable and will show on the next payroll as a one-time benefit. We surface it clearly in the policy doc.

Devon: If someone needs more than 3 days because of shipment delays or longer housing waits?

Leah - People Ops: Escalate to People Ops. We can authorize additional paid or unpaid time case-by-case (manager + People Ops approval). Don't promise — route to us.

HR-Bot: Official policy uploaded: `https://redwoodintra.company/policies/erl.pdf` — Slack-friendly FAQ at the bottom.

Leah - People Ops: We're holding a live Q&A tomorrow 9:00am PT in #people-ops-office-hours for managers and ICs who want a walkthrough. RSVP via the calendar invite in the policy doc.

Samir: Cheers — I'll forward to the folks on relocation track. :thumbsup:

Devon: Appreciate it, especially the quick-approve option. :relieved:

Marta - People Ops: FYI managers — we'll push a short admin guide and sample Workday approval comments by EOD. :eyes:
